You can export your Firefox bookmarks for use in other browsers.  This article shows you how to export your Firefox bookmarks and import them into Safari.

{for win, linux}
{note} '''Note:''' This article applies to Mac. The Safari browser is {for win}no longer available for Windows{/for}{for linux}not currently available for Linux{/for}.{/note}
{/for}

__TOC__

= Exporting bookmarks from Firefox =
[[T:ExportHTMLBookmarks]]
Your bookmarks are successfully exported from Firefox, to import them into Safari proceed to the next section.

= Importing bookmarks into Safari =
# Start Safari
# On the menu bar, click on the {menu File} menu and choose {menu Import Bookmarks...}.<br/> <br/>[[Image:exportingtosafari-mac-4.jpg]]<br/>
# Find the file you saved from Firefox and click {button Import}.<br/> <br/>[[Image:exportingtosafari-mac-5.jpg]]<br/>
Click on the {menu Bookmarks} menu to ensure all of your bookmarks have been successfully imported.
